Title: Lemon Cream Pasta With Cauliflower
Description: Creamy lemon pasta with cauliflower blanched in the pasta water, then browned in butter for caramelized edges. Finished with toasted breadcrumbs and served with lemon wedges. An easy vegetarian weeknight dinner.

Title: Black Bean Soup With Orange-Jalapeno Salsa
Description: A mild, kid-friendly black bean soup with a bright orange-jalapeno salsa on top, so everyone can add as much heat as they like. Easy to make vegan. A hearty vegetarian soup for cold nights.
Keywords: black bean soup,vegetarian soup,vegan black bean soup,orange jalapeno salsa,easy soup recipes

Title: Bunuelos (Sephardic Doughnuts)
Description: Bunuelos are yeast-raised fried doughnuts from my family's Sephardic tradition, served with honey for Hanukkah. A rustic fried dough recipe that is easy to make vegan.
